hook: 捗 means progress: when work goes well, it moves forward quickly.
Break (破) and throw away (棄): tear up a deal and toss it out.
剥 means peel: you peel or tear off the skin or label.
Press (迫) and harm (害): pushing people hard and hurting them, persecution.
Thin (薄) and weak (弱): too thin and weak to stand strong.
Make your situation (状) white (白) and clean: tell the truth, confess.
漠 is a wide empty desert: everything looks vague and unclear.
Explode (爆) + bullet (弾): a bullet that explodes, a bomb.
Explode (爆) and break (破): blow something up.
Violent (暴) + expose (露): roughly pull a secret out into the open.
励 means encourage: you cheer your friend on so they keep going.
励 means strive: you push yourself and work hard.
剥 means peel: the paint peels off and fades.
化 means change: a fox changes its form, like a ghost (お化け).
Branch (派) out and dispatch (遣): send people out to another place.
恥 means shame: a shy girl blushes with a little shame.
Bridge (橋) + hand over (渡し): be the bridge between two people.
弾 means bounce: a ball bounces, and your heart bounces with joy.
Naked (裸) foot (足): walking barefoot.
果 means fruit, result: you get the result, you carry it out.
Bee (蜂) + honey (蜜): honey from bees.
Start (発) + grow up (育): a body starting to grow.

Bring out (発) by digging (掘): dig up old things, or find new talent.
Start (発) + be born (生): something springs up, it happens.
Serve (仕) + make stand (立てる): make cloth stand up as a suit, tailor it.
Take (取り) your old one down (下) in price: the shop takes it as part payment, a trade in.

Lose (失) your rank (格): you are disqualified.
Question (質) + doubt (疑): asking about what you doubt, a Q and A.
Lose (失) your leg (脚): you lose your footing and fall from power.
Real (実) business (業) person (家): a businessman who runs real companies.
Body (身) + beautiful (美): teach the body beautiful manners, discipline.
躾 is body (身) + beautiful (美): teach a child to act beautifully.
Real (実) + step (践): really step forward and do it, practice.
Lose (失) harmony (調): the body loses its balance.
Both kanji have 女 (woman) inside: an old picture of jealousy.
Actual (実) cost (費): pay just the real cost, no profit.
Helping (助) verb (動詞): a word that helps the main verb.
淑 means graceful, gentle: a graceful, ladylike manner.
萎 means wither: a plant shrivels and goes limp.
Excrement (屎) + urine (尿): human waste.
Land (地) + master (主): the owner of the land, a landlord.
凌 means bear and rise above: you endure, then do better than others.
Start (始) + depart (発): the train that leaves first.
Ear (耳) + nose (鼻) + department (科): the ear and nose doctor.
Private (私) + thing (物): your own personal things.
Manage (司) + law (法): running the law, the justice system.
染 means dye: liquid soaks in like dye, and cold soaks into you.
Use (使) your life (命): the job you give your life to, a mission.
See (視) + field (野): the whole field you can see.
Society (社) + mixing (交): mixing with people in society.
Decline (謝) and cut off (絶): firmly refuse, like no visitors allowed.
Company (社) + house (宅): a house the company owns for workers.
Young (若) + dry (干): a young plant with only a few dry leaves, just some, a few.
Three (三) tastes (味) on strings (線): a three string Japanese instrument.
Slanted (斜) + surface (面): a slope.
Starts with sand (砂): gravel, small stones like big sand.
Sound hook: someone stylish shares (しゃれ) a clever joke.
Private (私) + have (有): something owned privately.
Around (周) + period (期): a period that goes around again, a cycle.
Take up (就) + work (業): start working, employment.
Follow (従) + work (業) + member (員): a member who works under a boss.
Gather (集) + count (計): gather numbers and add them up.
Attack (襲) + strike (撃): a sudden attack or raid.
Take in (収) + pay out (支): money in and money out.
Study (修) + scholar (士): a scholar who studied more, a master's degree.
Follow (従) + work, matter (事): to be engaged in some work.
Fill (充) + fruit, real (実): full like ripe fruit, rich and complete.
Take in (収) + gather (集): collecting things.
A road (路) shaped like the character (字) for ten (十): a crossroads.

Hold tight (執) + stick (着): you hold on and cannot let go.
Take in (収) + hold (容): take people or things in and hold them.
Follow (従) + come (来): the way things have come until now.
Protect (守) + guard (衛): the guard at the gate.
Main (主) + perform (演): play the main part.
Main, self (主) + view (観): seeing from your own point of view.
Lodged (宿) in your life (命): fate that lives inside you from birth.
Hand (手) + art (芸): arts made by hand, handicrafts.
Master (主) + power (権): the highest power of a country.
Main (主) + hold (催): the main one who holds the event.
Aim (趣) + main point (旨): the purpose and point of something.
Kind (種) + kind (々): many kinds, all sorts.
Main (主) food (食): the main food you eat every day, like rice.
Main (主) topic (題): the main theme.
Come out (出) and perform (演): appear on stage or TV.
Out (出) blood (血): bleeding.
Come out (出) and appear (現): something suddenly appears.
Come out (出) and be born (生): birth.
Come out (出) and be born (生): birth.
Tiny (微) amount (量): a very small amount.
Noon (昼) + meal (飯): lunch (a casual word).
Compare (比) + example (例): things grow together, in proportion.
Poor (貧) + trouble (困): poor and in trouble, poverty.
Poor (貧) + weak (弱): poor and weak, not much to it.
Goods (品) + kind, seed (種): a type or breed of plant or animal.
Frequent (頻) + busy (繁): happening again and again, very often.
Poor (貧) + lacking (乏): poor and short of everything.
Not (不) + intention (意): not expected, sudden.
Seal (封) + chain (鎖): seal and chain it shut, a blockade.
Wind (風) + wheel (車): a wheel turned by wind, a windmill.
Style (風) + habit (習): the habits and ways of a place, customs.
Style (風) + custom (俗): the customs of the people (also: sex industry).
Wind (風) + earth (土): the weather and land of a place.
Not (不) can (可) lack (欠): you cannot do without it, essential.
Not (不) lucky (吉): a bad sign, unlucky.
Cloth (布) + towel (巾): a small cloth for wiping dishes.
Many (複) + combine (合): many parts put together, composite.

Cover (覆) + face (面): a mask.
膨 means swell: cheeks swell up when you sulk.
耽 has an ear (耳): your ear is lost in something, you are absorbed.
老 means old: to get old, to look older.
Rich (富) + mighty (豪): a very rich, powerful person.
Spread (布) + announce (告): spread an official announcement.
Carry, owe (負) + debt (債): debts you carry.
Not (不) + be there (在): absent, not home.
Not (不) in order (順): irregular, like strange weather.
Bear (負) a wound (傷): to get injured.
Look down on (侮) + shame (辱): an insult.
Military (武) + equip (装): equipped with weapons, armed.
Not (不) in tune (調): out of tune, in bad shape.
Return (復) to life (活): coming back to life, a revival.
Thing (物) + debate (議): something everyone argues about.
Return (復) to old (旧): back to how it was before, restored.
Buddha (仏) + image (像): a statue of Buddha.
Thing (物) + body (体): a physical object.
Boil (沸) + rise (騰): water boils and bubbles up.
Not (不) + right (当): unfair, unjust.
Not (不) moving (動) property (産): property that cannot move, real estate.
No (無) + difficulty (難): no trouble, safe.
Rot (腐) + ruin (敗): rotting, and people going bad.
Not (不) + review (評): bad reviews, unpopular.
Not (不) + obey (服): not accepting it, unhappy.
Universal (普) + everywhere (遍): true everywhere, universal.
踏 means step on: stand firmly on the facts, base it on them.
Step (踏み) + go in (込む): step into a place or a topic.
Not (不) + clear (明): unknown, not clear.
Section (部) + gate (門): a section of a group, a department.
Help (扶) + feed (養): support and feed your family.
Shake (振り) out (出し): shake out the dice to start, the starting point.
Float (浮) + power (力): the power that makes things float.
Military (武) + power (力): armed force.
震 means shake: make your voice or body tremble.
No (無) + manners (礼): rude.
Attach (付) + record (録): extra pages attached, a supplement.
Anger (憤) + sigh (慨): angry and upset, indignation.
Culture (文化) + treasure (財): cultural treasures.
Divide (分) + work (業): split the work, each does one part.
Writing (文) + language (語): written, literary language.
Divide (分) + scatter (散): spread out in many places.
Part (分) + child (子): a tiny part (molecule), or the top of a fraction.
Mix up (紛) + lose (失): it gets mixed up and lost.
Spout (噴) + out (出): gush out, like a fountain.
Tangle (紛) + fight (争): a tangled fight, a dispute.
Divide (分) + carry (担): share the load.
Fire up (奮) + fight (闘): fight with all your energy.
Divide (分) + hand out (配): share out.
Part (分) + mother (母): the mother under the fraction line, the denominator.
Powder (粉) + end, tip (末): fine powder.
Divide (分) + separate (離): pull apart.
Shut (閉) mouth (口): so stuck you cannot speak, fed up.
Close (閉) + chain (鎖): close and lock up, shut down.
Calm (平) + usual (常): normal, as usual.
Flat (平) + square (方): a flat square, like square meters.
Line up (並) + row (列): side by side in a row.
辟 (step aside) + 易 (change): you back away, fed up.
隔 means separate: two things are far apart.
Speak (弁) + untie (解): talk to untie the problem, make an excuse.
Change (変) + reform (革): big change, reform.
Return (返) + come back (還): give it back.
Convenient (便) + suitable (宜): what is convenient and fitting.
Leaning (偏) + view (見): a one sided view, prejudice.
Speak (弁) + protect (護): speak to protect someone, defense.
Return (返) + settle (済): pay back money.
Change (変) + move (遷): changes over time.
Return (返) + answer (答): give an answer back.
Speech (弁) + argument (論): a debate.
穂 has grain (禾): the head of a rice or wheat plant.
Protect (保) + raise (育): look after and raise children.
Law (法) + plan, draft (案): a draft law, a bill.
Defend (防) + guard (衛): defense.
Prevent (防) + fire (火): fire prevention.
Crumble (崩) + break (壊): fall apart, collapse.
Block (妨) + harm (害): get in the way, obstruction.
Law (法) + study (学): the study of law.
Fief (封) + build (建): lords building on given land, feudal.
Method (方) + plan (策): a plan or policy.
Offer (奉) + serve (仕): offer your service.
Way (方) + style (式): a method or system.
Release (放) + shoot (射): shoot out rays, radiation.
Release (放) + shoot (射) + ability (能): the power to give off rays, radioactivity.
Release (放) + out (出): let it out, release.
報 means report: to report news.
報 means report: to report news (older form of 報じる).
Spin (紡) + spin thread (績): spinning thread.
Let go (放) + put (置): put it down and leave it alone.
Swell (膨) + stretch (張): grow bigger, expand.
Law (法) + court (廷): a courtroom.
